LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT MODIFIED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AND RULED AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANTS YANDY CHEN, AND LI ZHEN LIU'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT IS OVERRULED WITH 5 DAYS LEAVE TO ANSWER. IT IS CORRECT THAT THE DEMURRER WAS SPECIFICALLY ADDRESSED TO THE COMPLAINT AS A WHOLE AND WHILE THAT SHOULD HAVE BEEN RAISED EARLIER, IT DOES DEFINE THE ISSUES BEFORE THE COURT. THERE CANNOT HAVE BEEN ANY PREJUDICE FROM THAT BECAUSE THE SUBSTANCE OF THE ISSUES IS BEING ADDRESSED. THE COURT RECOGNIZING THAT THERE MAY BE SUBSTANTIVE ISSUES LEFT WITH RESPECT TO ONE OF THE THREE CAUSES OF ACTION, THESE CAN BE ADDRESSED IN OTHER WAYS AS THIS LITIGATION GOES FORWARD. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189
